samples.label: Flowchart
samples.description: A request is checked for a signed-in visitor, then for a cached page; an uncached page is rendered first.
samples.source:
flowchart TD
  request[Incoming request] --> auth{Signed in?}
  auth -->|yes| cache{In the cache?}
  auth -->|no| login[Sign-in page]
  cache -->|yes| page[Cached page]
  cache -->|no| render[Render the page]
  render --> page

samples.label: Sequence
samples.description: A reader opens a guide. The site asks the build for the page, the build returns HTML with inline SVG, and the site sends it to the reader.
samples.source:
sequenceDiagram
  actor Reader
  participant Site as Documentation site
  participant Build
  Reader->>Site: Open the guide
  Site->>Build: Page not cached
  Build-->>Site: HTML with inline SVG
  Site-->>Reader: The page, diagrams included

samples.label: Class
samples.description: A document holds any number of blocks. Block is an interface that paragraphs and diagrams implement.

samples.label: State
samples.description: A page starts as a draft, goes to review, returns to draft when changes are requested, and is published, then archived.
samples.source:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Draft
  Draft --> Review: submit
  Review --> Draft: request changes
  Review --> Published: approve
  Published --> Archived: retire
  Archived --> [*]

samples.label: Entity relationship
samples.description: An author writes articles, an article contains sections, and a section shows diagrams.

samples.label: Gantt
samples.description: A guide is drafted and its diagrams drawn at the same time; review follows both, and the guide is published once review ends.
samples.source:
gantt
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  axisFormat %b %d
  todayMarker off
  section Writing
    Draft the guide: draft, 2026-03-02, 5d
    Draw the diagrams: diagrams, 2026-03-02, 4d
  section Release
    Review: review, after draft diagrams, 3d
    Publish: milestone, after review, 0d

samples.label: Mindmap
samples.description: A release around its center: what changes in the code, what the documentation needs, and how it is announced.
samples.source:
mindmap
  root((Release))
    Code
      New diagram type
      Faster layout
    Documentation
      Guide
      Changelog
    Announcement
      Blog post
      Release notes

samples.label: Pie
samples.description: Where the diagrams of a documentation site come from: most are flowcharts, then sequence, class and state diagrams.
samples.source:
pie title Diagrams in the guide
  "Flowchart" : 42
  "Sequence" : 18
  "Class" : 9
  "State" : 6

samples.label: Quadrant
samples.description: Four pages of a guide placed by how often they are read and how out of date they are; the setup page is read most and needs an update.
samples.source:
quadrantChart
  title Which pages to update first
  x-axis Rarely read --> Often read
  y-axis Up to date --> Out of date
  quadrant-1 Update now
  quadrant-2 Plan an update
  quadrant-3 Leave as is
  quadrant-4 Keep an eye on
  Setup: [0.8, 0.75]
  Themes: [0.35, 0.6]
  API reference: [0.7, 0.25]
  Changelog: [0.2, 0.15]

samples.label: XY chart
samples.description: Diagrams rendered per month in a documentation build, from January to June, as bars with a line over them; the number grows every month.
samples.source:
xychart-beta
  title "Diagrams rendered per month"
  x-axis [Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun]
  y-axis "Diagrams" 0 --> 500
  bar [120, 180, 210, 290, 360, 430]
  line [120, 180, 210, 290, 360, 430]

samples.label: Pipeline
samples.description: Diagram text is parsed and its labels measured. One of three layouts follows, the SVG is painted and written to a file; a syntax error is reported instead.
samples.source:
flowchart LR
  text([Diagram text]) --> parse[Parse]
  parse --> measure[Measure the labels]
  measure --> flow[Lay out a flowchart]
  measure --> sequence[Lay out a sequence]
  measure --> other[Lay out another type]
  flow --> paint[Paint the SVG]
  sequence --> paint
  other --> paint
  paint --> file[(SVG file)]
  parse -. syntax error .-> report[Report the line]

samples.label: Decision
samples.description: A reader opens a page. A page in the cache is taken from there, another one is rendered first; either way the page is sent and shown.
samples.source:
flowchart TD
  open([Reader opens a page]) --> cached{In the cache?}
  cached -->|yes| stored[Take the stored page]
  cached -->|no| render[Render the page]
  stored --> send[Send the page]
  render --> send
  send --> shown([Page shown])

samples.label: Review
samples.description: A guide is written, reviewed, approved and published, and the release is announced. Requested changes send it back to writing, and a typo fix is published at once.
samples.source:
flowchart TD
  write[Write the guide] --> review[Review it]
  review --> approve[Approve it]
  approve --> publish[Publish it]
  write -->|typo fix| publish
  review -->|changes requested| write
  publish --> announce([Announce the release])

samples.label: States
samples.description: A guide starts as a draft. Submitting it puts it in review, where it is approved and published or sent back with requested changes. A published guide is archived at the end. A note says that two editors read every guide.
samples.source:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Draft
  Draft --> Review : submit
  Review --> Draft : request changes
  Review --> Published : approve
  Published --> Archived : archive
  Archived --> [*]
  note right of Review
    Two editors read
    every guide.
  end note
